title: Stage 1 — brainstorm gate (review + lock evidence + advance)

phases.name: Reviewer gate (Rule 15 gate 1: brainstorm + master review)

tasks.to: batch 1 record: reviewers=[reviewer-1], version under review=brainstorm v1.2.0 + master v1.0

reviewer reads brainstorm + master + migrated PRD; checks: user directives Q1-Q4 + D11-D13 fully captured; Rule 5 format compliance; stage table vs decision references; internal contradictions; migration/deletion set exactly the 7 files

test.command: review report arrives with numbered findings + verdict
test.reviewer_check: findings cite evidence (doc section/field); no CRITICAL/MAJOR expected for AGREED

phases.name: Gate close: findings disposition + checklist + advance

tasks.to: FIXED (with proof) or DISMISSED (with reason) per finding
checklist reviewed -> approved -> locked for brainstorm + master docs; --record-review 1 AGREED reviewer-1

merge_and_close.close: commit review log + any fixes; report gate result
